_tokenSources: Where the tokens these files read are DECLARED. roots is src, but the tokens live in the submodule, so without this every var() into shared reads as undefined.
_runtimeTokens: Set by JS as an inline style on the element itself, so no stylesheet declares them: the zone/tab colours and --labels-w from App.tsx + GlyphGroups.tsx, --flash-color from scenes.tsx, and --vs/--vm-lh/--vm-shift from CossScene.tsx.
_lines: On the house grid (wm-primitives GRID.md). The APP: src/instrument/shell.css (the rail, the canvas bar, the mode row, the play rail, the panels) and src/instrument/scenes.css (the scene bars) -- since #root is .wm-lines. And the compare pages' article, src/landing.css, written into dist/landing.css by scripts/gen-landing.mjs. linesSkip names what in them is not on the line: the stages (data-nosnap in the page, their type the user's) -- the specimen and the paragraph scene (.specimen, .para), the Scale tiers (.tier-*), the glyph grid, the compare inline; in the article, the specimen rows, the style cap and the letterbox, which sits outside the .wm-lines root and pulls its canvas up by the bleed.
